Modern.Attributes: Energy Immune Boss Immunities: Freeze Immunity Energy Immunity Poison Slowdown
Modern.Ability 1: Rocket Barrage - Ducky D00M fires a barrage of rockets into the air which crash into the ground, stunning towers within the rockets' explosions. Can only be used after Rage Mode is activated.
Modern.Ability 2: Chainsaw Dash - Ducky D00M pulls out a chainsaw and dashes towards the base dealing 100 damage and stunning towers that get hit. If Ducky D00M is close to the center of the map, it may maneuver to hit more towers.
Modern.Ability 3: Trundle - A passive ability that causes towers to be stunned if Ducky D00M ran over them.
Modern.Ability 4: Minigun Spray - Ducky D00M fires its miniguns underneath its wings, which stuns any towers hit. Can only be used after Rage Mode is activated.
Modern.Ability 5: Nerd n' Shotgun - Ducky D00M fires its side guns, which produces a shotgun-like spray of bullets, stunning towers hit and dealing at least 50 damage to units.
Modern.Ability 6: Nerd Laughter - Ducky D00M squeals loudly, shaking the camera.
Modern.Ability 7: Rage Mode - At half health, it squeals for a medium duration, its body extends further from the tread-tracks and it gains the ability to use Rocket Barrage and Minigun Spray . Three P3NGUs spawn in.

Modern.Ability 3: Infernal Storm - Lord Sinister breathes fire, setting towers alight, which stuns them. This also deals 150 damage per tick to units .

eggy_island.name: Eggy Island
eggy_island.description: Eggy Island was the event map for the Spring 2020 Event. Like other event maps, it had a specialized wave structure with special enemies.

Modern.Triumph Rewards: 180, 25 EXP, 100-250 Tickets & Tower of Eggs (Easy) 270, 37 EXP, 375-750 Tickets & Swarmer (Hard)

zombegg.name: Zombegg
zombegg.description: The Zombegg was an enemy that appeared in Eggy Island as part of Spring 2020 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Spring 2020 (Easy) Spring 2020 (Hard)
Modern.Speed: Below Average (Easy Mode) Average (3, Hard Mode)

sugrawr.name: Sugrawr
sugrawr.description: The Sugrawr was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Eggy Island as part of the Spring 2020 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Spring 2020 (Easy) Spring 2020 (Hard)
Modern.Speed: Above Average (Easy Mode) Fast (6, Hard Mode)

eggsplosive.name: Eggsplosive
eggsplosive.description: The Eggsplosive was an enemy that appeared in Eggy Island as part of the Spring 2020 Event. It had 40 health in easy mode and 75 health in hard mode.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Spring 2020 (Easy) Spring 2020 (Hard)
Modern.Speed: Average (Easy Mode) Slightly Fast (5, Hard Mode)
Modern.Ability: Explosion - Upon its death, the Eggsplosive would explode, stunning nearby towers for 10 seconds.

hunter_eggy_island.name: Hunter
hunter_eggy_island.description: The Hunter was an enemy that only appeared in Eggy Island as part of the Spring 2020 Event. It appeared in easy mode and hard mode with the same amount of health.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Spring 2020 (Easy) Spring 2020 (Hard)
Modern.Speed: Average (Easy Mode) Above Average (4, Hard Mode)
Modern.Ability: Bow - Shoots an arrow at a tower, stunning it for a few seconds.

bunny.name: Bunny
bunny.description: The Bunny was an enemy that only appeared in Eggy Island as part of the Spring 2020 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Spring 2020 (Easy) Spring 2020 (Hard)
Modern.Ability: Carrot Throw - The Bunny throws a carrot which stuns a specific tower and all towers in the immediate impact area.

sir_hopsalot.name: Sir Hopsalot
sir_hopsalot.description: Sir Hopsalot was a knight-bunny enemy that exclusively appeared in Eggy Island as part of the Spring 2020 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Spring 2020 (Easy) Spring 2020 (Hard)
Modern.Speed: Slow (Easy Mode) Slightly Slow (2, Hard Mode)
Modern.Ability 1: Carrot Throw - Throws its carrot at a tower, which stuns the target and other towers in the immediate area.
Modern.Ability 2: Shield - Holds its shield in front of its body, limiting most forms of damage towards it to a maximum of two.

beehive.name: Beehive
beehive.description: The Beehive was an enemy that only appeared in Eggy Island hard mode as part of the Spring 2020 Event. This did not appear in easy mode.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Spring 2020 (Hard)

grizzly.name: Grizzly
grizzly.description: The Grizzly was a bear that only appeared in Eggy Island hard mode as part of the Spring 2020 Event. It did not appear in easy mode.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Spring 2020 (Hard)
Modern.Ability 1: Heal - Heals about 50 health. Red crosses can be seen when the Grizzly is healing.
Modern.Ability 2: Claw - Attacks a nearby tower. Any tower caught in the range of the claw attack is stunned for a while.
Modern.Ability 3: Beehive - Chews on a beehive which makes it immune to most forms of damage.

ducky_d00m_eggy_island.name: Ducky D00M
ducky_d00m_eggy_island.description: Ducky D00M (or Ducky Doom) was a major boss and the final enemy to appear in Eggy Island as part of the Spring 2020 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Spring 2020 (Easy) Spring 2020 (Hard)
Modern.Attributes: Boss Immunities: Freeze Immunity Burn Immunity
Modern.Ability 1: Ground Pound - Ducky D00M pounds the ground, stunning nearby towers.
Modern.Ability 2: Dual Miniguns - Ducky D00M fires its miniguns, stunning towers that are hit by the lasers.

village_of_despair.name: Village of Despair
village_of_despair.description: Village of Despair was the event map for the Christmas 2019 Event. Like other event maps, it had a specialized wave structure with special enemies.

frozen_village_of_despair.name: Frozen
frozen_village_of_despair.description: It was the first enemy to spawn in Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event. It had 60 health and walked at an average speed.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Christmas 2019

snowman_village_of_despair.name: Snowman
snowman_village_of_despair.description: The Snowman was an enemy that only appeared in Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event. It was slightly faster and had more health than the Frozen.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Christmas 2019

gingerbread_village_of_despair.name: Gingerbread
gingerbread_village_of_despair.description: The Gingerbread exclusively appeared in Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Christmas 2019
Modern.Ability: Explode - The Gingerbread explodes upon death, stunning nearby towers.

burnt_gingerbread.name: Burnt Gingerbread
burnt_gingerbread.description: The Burnt Gingerbread was an enemy that appeared in Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Christmas 2019
Modern.Ability: Fireball - The Burnt Gingerbread throws a fireball at a tower, setting it alight, stunning the tower for about 10 seconds.

deep_freeze_village_of_despair.name: Deep Freeze
deep_freeze_village_of_despair.description: The Deep Freeze was an ice elemental enemy. It appeared in Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Christmas 2019

papa_bread_village_of_despair.name: Papa Bread
papa_bread_village_of_despair.description: Papa Bread appeared exclusively in Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event. Papa Bread was a gingerbread with the ability to summon Presents.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Christmas 2019
Modern.Ability: Time of Giving - Papa Bread slams the ground with its candy cane and spawns four Presents .

present_village_of_despair.name: Present
present_village_of_despair.description: The Present was an enemy that only appeared in the Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event. The Present was mainly spawned from the Papa Bread.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Christmas 2019
Modern.Attributes: Splash Damage Immune Basic Freeze Immune

yeti_village_of_despair.name: Yeti
yeti_village_of_despair.description: The Yeti is an enemy that exclusively appeared in Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Sandbox via Logbooks Originally: Christmas 2019
Modern.Ability: Swipe - The Yeti swipes at a nearby tower, stunning it for a short period of time.

frost_tank.name: Frost Tank
frost_tank.description: The Frost Tank was an ice version of the original version of the Tank. It only appeared in Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Christmas 2019
Modern.Ability: Rock Throw - The Frost Tank picks up an ice boulder and throws it at nearby towers, stunning towers hit.

frost_hero_village_of_despair.name: Frost Hero
frost_hero_village_of_despair.description: The Frost Hero was an ice elemental enemy that appeared in Village of Despair as part of the Christmas 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Legacy Fallen Christmas 2019
Modern.Ability 1: Rock Throw - Throws a rock at a tower, stunning it for a long period of time.
Modern.Ability 2: Sword Swing - Swings its sword in a 180° arc, stunning all towers hit.

krampus_village_of_despair.name: Krampus
krampus_village_of_despair.description: Krampus appeared exclusively in Village of Despair as the final boss of the Christmas 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Christmas 2019
Modern.Attributes: Boss Immunities: Freeze Immunity Burn Immunity
Modern.Ability 1: Stomp - Krampus roars and slams its staff into the ground. This creates a shockwave, stunning all towers hit by it.
Modern.Ability 2: Summon - Krampus summons Frozen, Gingerbreads, Burnt Gingerbreads, Snowmans, Deep Freezes and Yetis .
Modern.Ability 3: Crystallize - Krampus creates a line of ice with its staff, freezing all towers in the line.
Modern.Ability 4: Icicle Storm - Krampus summons a snowstorm, causing fog to descend. It rains icicles which can hit towers, stunning them for a long period of time. It can only occur after Rage Mode .
Modern.Ability 5: Rage Mode - Krampus takes off its helmet, stands still, and heals 100,000 as part of its Rage Mode . Becomes immune to most forms of damage while doing this (except unit collision damage). It can only occur once.

nightmare_carnival.name: Nightmare Carnival
nightmare_carnival.description: Nightmare Carnival was once a normal map in rotation, but it was an event map during the Halloween 2019 Event.

mummy_nightmare_carnival.name: Mummy
mummy_nightmare_carnival.description: The Mummy was an enemy that only appeared in Nightmare Carnival as a part of the Halloween 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019

strong_mummy.name: Strong Mummy
strong_mummy.description: The Strong Mummy was an enemy that appeared in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event. Compared to the Mummy, it had more health, but was slower.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019

scarecrow_nightmare_carnival.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow_nightmare_carnival.description: The Scarecrow was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019

demon_nightmare_carnival.name: Demon
demon_nightmare_carnival.description: The Demon was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event. Currently, it can only appear in Sandbox mode.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Sandbox via Logbooks Originally: Halloween 2019

ghost_nightmare_carnival.name: Ghost
ghost_nightmare_carnival.description: The Ghost was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019
Modern.Attributes: Splash Damage Immune Burn Immune Basic Freeze Immune

vampire_nightmare_carnival.name: Vampire
vampire_nightmare_carnival.description: The Vampire was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019
Modern.Ability: Bat Transformation - When the Vampire is killed, it turns into a Bat .

bat_nightmare_carnival.name: Bat
bat_nightmare_carnival.description: The Bat was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event. It was spawned after a Vampire was killed.

witch_nightmare_carnival.name: Witch
witch_nightmare_carnival.description: The Witch was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019

reaper_nightmare_carnival.name: Reaper
reaper_nightmare_carnival.description: The Reaper was a summoner enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019
Modern.Ability: Hallo-Spawn - Reaper spawns Scarecrows, Ghosts, Mummies and Strong Mummies from the ground.

clown_nightmare_carnival.name: Clown
clown_nightmare_carnival.description: The Clown was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event and was the fastest enemy in the event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Sandbox via Logbooks Originally: Halloween 2019

frankenstein_nightmare_carnival.name: Frankenstein
frankenstein_nightmare_carnival.description: Frankenstein was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019

swamp_thing.name: Swamp Thing
swamp_thing.description: The Swamp Thing was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019

jaxe_nightmare_carnival.name: Jaxe
jaxe_nightmare_carnival.description: The Jaxe was an enemy that first appeared in Nightmare Carnival as part of the Halloween 2019 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen Halloween 2019
Modern.Ability: Axe Swing - The Jaxe swings its axe in one direction hitting towers and stunning them.

jack_o_bot.name: Jack O' Bot
jack_o_bot.description: Jack O' Bot appeared exclusively in Nightmare Carnival as the final boss of the Halloween 2019 Event. It had a high amount of health and three abilities.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Halloween 2019
Modern.Attributes: Boss Immunities: Freeze Immunity Burn Immunity
Modern.Ability 1: Jack O' Minigun - Jack O' Bot fires lasers from its right arm machine gun in a sweeping fashion. This will stun any towers hit.
Modern.Ability 2: Jack O' Bombs - Jack O' Bot fires three explosive pumpkins at three different towers. These pumpkins explode upon impact, stunning all towers within the explosion radius.
Modern.Ability 3: Hallowed Laugh - Jack O' Bot stands still while laughing and spawning various enemies.

area_51.name: Area 51
area_51.description: Area 51 was a nighttime map that was based on the Nevada Test and Training Range, more commonly known as Area 51.

alien_area_51.name: Alien
alien_area_51.description: The Alien was the first Area 51 enemy that spawned in the event. The Alien had the same speed as the Normal, but had more health than it.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Area 51

strong_alien.name: Strong Alien
strong_alien.description: The Strong Alien was the second enemy that spawned in Area 51 as part of the Area 51 Event. It had the same speed as the Alien, but had higher health.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Area 51

zoomer.name: Zoomer
zoomer.description: The Zoomer was an enemy that only appeared in Area 51 as part of the Area 51 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Area 51

lawnmower.name: Lawnmower
lawnmower.description: The Lawnmower was an Area 51 enemy that only appeared during the Area 51 Event. Though it was slower than the Alien...

Modern.Mode Appearance: Area 51

hidden_zoomer.name: Hidden Zoomer
hidden_zoomer.description: The Hidden Zoomer was an enemy that only appeared during the Area 51 Event. It was slightly faster than the Zoomer and had more health than it.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Area 51

ufo_area_51.name: UFO
ufo_area_51.description: The UFO, which stands for Unidentified Flying Object, was an enemy that only appeared in Area 51 as part of the Area 51 Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Area 51

raider_1.name: Raider 1
raider_1.description: The Raider 1 was an Area 51 enemy that only appeared during the Area 51 Event. It was the first raider to appear.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Area 51
Modern.Ability: Fire Gun - Fires a burning laser at a tower. This sets it on fire so that it cannot attack for 7-10 seconds.

raider_2.name: Raider 2
raider_2.description: The Raider 2 was an Area 51 enemy that only appeared during the Area 51 Event. It was the second raider to appear after the Raider 1.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Area 51
Modern.Ability: Ice Gun - Fires an ice laser at a tower. This would freeze that tower and other towers nearby.

raider_boss.name: Raider Boss
raider_boss.description: The Raider Boss was the final enemy of the Area 51 Event and only appeared in Area 51. Like most major bosses, it had high health and walked extremely slowly.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Area 51
Modern.Attributes: Basic Freeze Immune Splash Damage Immune
Modern.Ability 1: Raid Gun Shot - Shoots three random towers in its range which will stun them for 10-15 seconds.
Modern.Ability 2: Rocket Launcher - The Raider Boss fires four rockets from its quad launcher, stunning towers in a large radius for 7-15 seconds.
Modern.Ability 3: Raider Reinforcements - The Raider Boss summons a small group of Raider 1s and Raider 2s which walk from the spawn.
Modern.Ability 4: Fatal Raid Gun Shot - The Raider Boss kneels down and shoots a powerful shot at a humanoid tower, killing it, preventing it from attacking. It will disappear shortly after.

the_heights.name: The Heights
the_heights.description: The Heights is currently a regular map in rotation, but it was an event map during the SFOTH Event.

knight_the_heights.name: Knight
knight_the_heights.description: The Knight was an enemy that appeared in The Heights during the SFOTH Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: SFOTH

boomer_1.name: Boomer 1
boomer_1.description: The Boomer 1 was an enemy that exploded upon its death, stunning nearby towers in its radius. It was a fairly strong enemy with an average speed.

Modern.Ability: Explode - Upon its death, the Boomer 1 explodes into a bile bubble that stuns all towers caught in the bubble

stone_viking.name: Stone Viking
stone_viking.description: The Stone Viking was an enemy that appeared exclusively in The Heights as part of the SFOTH Event.

Modern.Mode Appearance: SFOTH

crystalite.name: Crystalite
crystalite.description: The Crystalite was an enemy that appeared exclusively in The Heights as part of the SFOTH Event. It had the same speed as the Normal Boss and Necromancer.

Modern.Mode Appearance: SFOTH
Modern.Ability: Explode - The Crystalite will, upon its death, create a bile bubble which stuns nearby towers upon its death.

brute_the_heights.name: Brute
brute_the_heights.description: The Brute was an enemy that appeared in The Heights as part of the SFOTH Event. It had the same walkspeed as the Stone Viking...

Modern.Mode Appearance: SFOTH
Modern.Ability: Rock Throw - The Brute briefly stops, picks up a rock and flings it at towers, stunning them for a period of time.

fallen_hero_the_heights.name: Fallen Hero
fallen_hero_the_heights.description: The Fallen Hero was an enemy that appeared in the SFOTH Event, where it could be considered the penultimate enemy in The Heights, as it spawned just before the...

Modern.Mode Appearance: SFOTH

swordmaster.name: Swordmaster
swordmaster.description: The Swordmaster wore a red cloak and pants. Painted on its cloak appeared to be a necklace. It had green skin, light red legs and a dark red shirt.

Modern.Mode Appearance: SFOTH
Modern.Ability 1: Sword Swing - Stuns nearby towers for 5 seconds with a sword swing.
Modern.Ability 2: Sword Smash - Stuns nearby towers for 5 seconds by smashing the ground with its sword.
Modern.Ability 3: Summon - Spawns various enemies at the spawn in random amounts.

blighted_legacy.name: Blighted
blighted_legacy.description: The Blighted was an enemy that used to have high health and average speed. It had more health and was slightly faster than the Slow Boss...

necromancer_2.name: Necromancer 2
necromancer_2.description: The Necromancer 2 was a summoner enemy that summoned three Strongs. It was a stronger version of the Necromancer...

Modern.Ability: Summon - Spawns three Strongs .

gravekeeper.name: Gravekeeper
gravekeeper.description: The Gravekeeper was considered to be the first major boss of the game to appear. It was the final enemy that appeared in Easy mode.

Modern.Ability 1: Tombstone - The Gravekeeper will raise its hammer in the air, creating four (rarely eight) Tombstones next to it.
Modern.Ability 2: Smash - The Gravekeeper will raise its hammer and smash it onto the ground, creating a 20 stud shockwave radius, stunning nearby towers.

super_mystery.name: Super Mystery
super_mystery.description: The Super Mystery, originally called the Mystery 2, was an enemy similar to the Mystery, but upon its death, it spawned the Molten, Normal Boss, Necromancer...

Modern.Mode Appearance: Beginner's Molten
Modern.Ability: Spawn - Upon its death, the Super Mystery spawns the Molten, Shock, Slow Boss, Necromancer, Normal Boss or Hidden Boss .

ultra_mystery.name: Ultra Mystery
ultra_mystery.description: The Ultra Mystery was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, being slightly slower than the Ninja, and it also had average health for its debut.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Golden Legacy Fallen
Modern.Ability: Spawn - Upon its death, the Ultra Mystery spawns a random enemy from the list.

uber_mystery.name: Uber Mystery
uber_mystery.description: The Uber Mystery was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, having nearly the same speed as the Quick, but it also had low health for its debut.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Golden Legacy Fallen
Modern.Ability: Spawn - Upon its death, the Uber Mystery spawns a random enemy from the list.

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.description: The Ninja was an enemy that could not be attacked by towers without hidden detection. Without hidden detection, the Ninja was a nuisance.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Golden Legacy Fallen
Modern.Spawned By: Dark Necromancer Mystery (Golden & Fallen) Ultra Mystery (Formerly)

strong.name: Strong
strong.description: The Strong was a stronger variant of the Slow that appeared in Easy mode. It had more health than the Slow and had the same speed as the Normal Boss.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Easy
Modern.Spawned By: Grave Digger (Easy only) Mystery (Easy only) Necromancer 2 (Formerly)

premega_modes.name: Pre-MEGA Modes
premega_modes.description: Before the MEGA Update, there were four main modes, these being the Easy, Normal, Hard and Insane modes.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: The Carrier, in-game referred to as Carrier 1 despite there only being one Carrier enemy, was a large, four-legged enemy, whom upon its death, exploded into 4...

Modern.Ability: Explode - The Carrier will, upon its death, create a huge bile bubble which stuns all towers caught in the radius. The Carrier will also split into four Swarms upon its death.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: The Swarm, in-game referred to as Swarm 1 despite there only being one Swarm enemy, was a four-legged enemy that was spawned from the Carrier when it died.

Modern.Ability: Explode - Stuns nearby towers within a small radius upon its death.

tank_2.name: Tank 2
tank_2.description: The Tank 2 was a stronger form of the Tank 1. It had the same speed as the Tank 1 while also having much more health than it.

Modern.Ability: ' Molten Rock Throw - The Tank 2 picks up a boulder and throws it at nearby towers, stunning towers hit.

boomer_2.name: Boomer 2
boomer_2.description: The Boomer 2 was mostly regarded as a heated version of the Boomer 1. However...

Modern.Ability: Explode - Upon its death, the Boomer 2 explodes into a large bile bubble that stuns all towers caught in the bubble.

controlled.name: Controlled
controlled.description: The Controlled appeared to be a normal enemy with average speed and low health for its debut.

Modern.Ability: Shrike Death - Upon its death, the Controlled spawns a Shrike Crystal .

shrike_crystal.name: Shrike Crystal
shrike_crystal.description: The Shrike Crystal was a crystal that appeared once a Controlled was killed. The crystal stunned nearby towers and were resistant to explosions.

Modern.Ability: Crystallise - Gradually expands, stunning all towers within a 7.5 stud radius until it reaches its maximum size.

rusted.name: Rusted
rusted.description: The Rusted was an enemy with an average speed and more health than the Chained. Though it was not considered a boss, it had high health for its debut.

witch_doctor.name: Witch Doctor
witch_doctor.description: The Witch Doctor was a support-type enemy that directly healed other enemies. The Witch Doctor spawned behind Chaineds...

Modern.Ability: Healing Power - Waves its staff up, healing 1/5th of an enemy's health. Heals all enemies that are within 7.5 studs of the Witch Doctor . Does not heal other Witch Doctors .

tombstone.name: Tombstone
tombstone.description: The Tombstone was an immobile enemy spawned by the Gravekeeper. It must be destroyed for the match to end and function essentially like an enemy.

Modern.Ability: Back from the Dead - When destroyed, the Tombstone spawns either the Normal, Slow, Hidden or Normal Boss .

frozen_premega.name: Frozen
frozen_premega.description: It had average speed (about the same as the Normal) and had the same amount of health as the Chained. It was immune to the Freezer's basic freeze.

deep_freeze_premega.name: Deep Freeze
deep_freeze_premega.description: The Deep Freeze was an ice elemental enemy. Compared to the Frozen, the Deep Freeze was slightly slower, but it had more health.

frost_hero_premega.name: Frost Hero
frost_hero_premega.description: The Frost Hero was the final enemy to appear on Insane mode. It had more health than the Gravekeeper.

Modern.Ability: Hammer Smash - Smashes its ice hammer into the ground, creating a small ice crystal, stunning towers in it.

polluted_wasteland.name: Polluted Wasteland
polluted_wasteland.description: Polluted Wasteland was a map that had recently been through a nuclear disaster. On Fallen and Golden modes, some of the enemies were replaced with nuclear variants.

Modern.Wave Structure: Normal ( Normal & Molten Modes) Nuclear ( Fallen & Golden Modes)

radioactive.name: Radioactive
radioactive.description: The Radioactive was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Polluted Wasteland Fallen mode and was a replacement for the Heavy in Polluted Wasteland.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen
Modern.Spawned By: Dark Necromancer ( Polluted Wasteland Golden & Fallen) Mystery ( Polluted Wasteland Golden & Fallen) Ultra Mystery (Formerly)

wasted_boss.name: Wasted Boss
wasted_boss.description: The Wasted Boss was an enemy found exclusively in Polluted Wasteland Fallen mode, replacing the Abnormal Boss.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen
Modern.Spawned By: Mystery ( Polluted Wasteland Fallen) Mystery Boss ( Polluted Wasteland Fallen) Ultra Mystery (Formerly) Uber Mystery (Formerly)

amalgamation_polluted_wasteland.name: Amalgamation
amalgamation_polluted_wasteland.description: The Amalgamation was an enemy that only appeared in Polluted Wasteland, replacing the Giant Boss.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen
Modern.Spawned By: Mystery Boss ( Polluted Wasteland Fallen) Nuclear Fallen King Uber Mystery (Formerly)
Modern.Ability: Regeneration - Heals 3% of its maximum health every second.

rusher_polluted_wasteland.name: Rusher
rusher_polluted_wasteland.description: The Rusher was an enemy that only appeared in Polluted Wasteland Fallen mode, replacing the Hazard.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen
Modern.Speed: Extremely Swift (12, With Shield) Above Average (Without Shield)
Modern.Spawned By: Mystery ( Polluted Wasteland Fallen, wave 29 onwards) Nuclear Fallen King

splitter_polluted_wasteland.name: Splitter
splitter_polluted_wasteland.description: The Splitter was an enemy that only appeared in Polluted Wasteland Fallen mode, replacing the Boomer.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen
Modern.Spawned By: Mystery Boss ( Polluted Wasteland Fallen, wave 35 onwards) Summoner Boss (Formerly)
Modern.Ability: Explode - Upon its death, the Splitter creates a bile bubble, stunning nearby towers. Also causes 2 Splits to be spawned.

split_polluted_wasteland.name: Split
split_polluted_wasteland.description: The Split was an enemy that only appeared in Polluted Wasteland Fallen mode. It did not spawn naturally, and was instead spawned by the Splitter upon its death.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen
Modern.Ability: Explode - Upon death, the Split creates a bile bubble, stunning nearby towers.

nuclear_fallen_king.name: Nuclear Fallen King
nuclear_fallen_king.description: The Nuclear Fallen King was the final boss of Polluted Wasteland Fallen mode. It replaced the Fallen King in Polluted Wasteland.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen
Modern.Attributes: Burn Immune Splash Damage Immune Energy Immune Boss Immunities: Freeze Immunity Energy Immunity
Modern.Ability 1: Summon - The Nuclear Fallen King will raise its sword and summon Fallens, Fallen Heroes, Circuits, Amalgamations and Rushers .
Modern.Ability 2: Stomp - The Nuclear Fallen King will teleport into the air and strike downwards, creating a shockwave with a huge radius stunning all ground towers hit. This will deal 750 damage to units .
Modern.Ability 3: Spin Slash - The Nuclear Fallen King spins around with its sword extended, stunning all nearby towers.
Modern.Ability 4: Acid Rain - The Nuclear Fallen King creates acid puddles which stuns towers for a long period of time. Also creates green lighting, stunning specific towers. This attack occurs for every ability used.
Modern.Ability 5: Block - The Nuclear Fallen King will block with its shield, taking no damage from all sources.
Modern.Ability 6: Rage Mode - Activates at half health. The Nuclear Fallen King will point its arms upwards, spawning 2-4 Fallen Guardians at spawn. It is briefly immune to all forms of damage. Attack frequency and walkspeed is increased.

hidden_wave_legacy.name: Hidden Wave
hidden_wave_legacy.description: The legacy version of the Hidden Wave was a secret wave that could have been accessed by defeating wave 40 on Fallen mode in 1,009 seconds (16 minutes and 49...

glitched_giant.name: Glitched Giant
glitched_giant.description: The Glitched Giant was a special enemy that only appeared in the legacy Hidden Wave, and thus only appeared in Fallen mode.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen

bruh.name: Bruh
bruh.description: The Bruh was an enemy that could only be found in the legacy Hidden Wave, meaning that it could only be found in Fallen mode.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen

bug.name: Bug
bug.description: The Bug was an enemy that could only be found in the legacy Hidden Wave, which meant it could only be found in Fallen mode.

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen

Modern.Mode Appearance: Fallen

void.name: Void
void.description: The Void was an exclusive boss only available via admin commands during certain 2020 private testing sessions, and has not been in the game in any way since.

Modern.Attributes: Boss Immunities: Freeze Immunity Energy Immunity
Modern.Ability 1: Stomp - The Void stomps, creating a large shockwave that stuns towers for around 5 seconds.
Modern.Ability 2: Summon - The Void will raise its hand and summon Mysteries, Mystery Bosses, Glitches, Lavas, Mega Slows, Abnormal Bosses and Shadow Bosses .
Modern.Ability 3: Rage - At half health, the Void screams and summons in four First Forms . Also has its torso, legs and crown turn red.
